item.title: Taken by ICE
item.description: Cecelia Lizotte owns Suya Joint, a celebrated Nigerian restaurant in Boston. She’s a rising star in the city who was nominated for a James Beard Award in 2024 and operates two restaurants and a food truck. item.title: Best Of: Mixed Marriage Project / How Racism Costs Everyone
item.description: Dorothy Roberts’ father was a white anthropologist who studied interracial marriages and her mother was a Black woman from Jamaica. She always assumed her parents' relationship inspired her father’s scholarly focus, but that changed after he died, and she found boxes of interviews he conducted with interracial couples, dating back to the 1930s, decades before he met her mother. item.title: Say She She at WARSAW
item.description: Say She She at WARSAWFeb. 20. 7PM. $37.50+up The three singers who lead the group Say She She are all classically trained, but they all like different things: 70s style New York dance music, classic soul and R&B, the swirling psychedelia of Turkish pop or Hindi film music. Together they make a kind of post-disco pop that features an effortless but irresistible dance beat and the trio’s own rich and subtle vocal harmonies.
